name: riptide
description: Send Flash's pictures and 3D models to Riptide, and build 3D worlds there, as layers in the project open there, to animate and put in a video. An SVG comes in as editable shapes and text.

tools.name: send_to_riptide
tools.description: Add a picture (.png, .jpg, .webp, .gif, .svg) or a 3D model (.glb, .gltf, .obj) to a project open in Riptide, the user's motion graphics editor, as a layer they can animate: the window used last, or the one named in window. Opens Riptide first when it is not open.

x.description: Optional: where a picture's centre goes, in canvas pixels.

window.description: Optional: which Riptide window, each a project of its own: a project's name or a window id from riptide_windows, or "new" for a new window. Left out, the window used last, only when one window is open: with more than one, give it (call riptide_windows first).

tools.name: riptide_world
tools.description: Build a 3D world in the project open in Riptide, to film: a procedural sky with a sun and clouds, the ground (an ocean that can throw up a breaking wave, a wheat field, desert dunes, a mountain valley with a winding road, pines and snowy peaks, or a studio floor), fog and dust, props built from parts with worn-metal, leatherette, aluminium, chrome, lens-glass and other finishes, and a lens with depth of field, bloom and grain. It goes under every layer; 3D shapes and models above it stand in it. Start from a scene, each keyed with a slow camera move, and change any setting with props. Opens Riptide first when it is not open.

scene.description: wave: a breaking wave at golden hour. rig: a worn film camera on a jib in a hazy wheat field, shallow focus. studio: a soft-lit floor for shapes and models. desert: dunes and a monolith at dusk. night: a moonlit sea. mountain: a red car up a winding road through pines under snowy peaks, filmed from behind. Empty for a bare world.

window.description: Optional: which Riptide window, each a project of its own: a project's name or a window id from riptide_windows, or "new" for a new window. Left out, the window used last, only when one window is open: with more than one, give it (call riptide_windows first).

props.description: Settings to change, all animatable in Riptide: sky (sunset, day, dusk, haze, overcast, night, studio), sunEl and sunAz (degrees; sunAz 0 is behind what the camera looks at), sunPower, clouds (%), wind (m/s); ground (ocean, field, desert, mountains, floor, none), groundColor; for mountains: peaks (m), snow (%), trees (%), road (width, m), and a car or camera on the road with road (m along it, keyed to drive), lane (m right of the middle) and lift (m up); water, waves (m), chop, swell (a breaking wave's height, m), curl (0 to 1, how far it has broken), waveDist, waveAngle; plants, grass (%), grassH (m); fog, dust (0 to 100); eye (camera height, m), heading, pitch (degrees), travel (m), lens (mm); dof, focus (m), exposure (stops), bloom, grain, fringe, ao (0 to 100); objects: a list of props in metres, {type: box|cylinder|sphere|cone|torus|capsule|truss|label|group, at: [x, y, z] (y up, z towards the camera), turn: [x, y, z] degrees, size: [w, h, d], finish: worn-metal|leatherette|aluminium|chrome|steel|rubber|plastic|paint|glass|lens|wood|concrete|rust|gold|glow, color, children: [...]}.

tools.name: riptide_windows
tools.description: The Riptide windows open in the browser, each a project of its own: their project names and ids, and which was used last. send_to_riptide and riptide_world take one of them as window.

commands.name: riptide
commands.description: send a picture or 3D model to Riptide (/riptide <path>, or the newest Flash showed)

settings.label: Riptide's address
settings.help: Where Riptide runs. The installer's riptide command serves it here.

settings.label: Open Riptide when it is not open
settings.help: Starts it, or opens its editor in your browser, before sending.

settings.label: SVGs as editable layers
settings.help: An SVG comes in as Riptide's own shapes and text, each one editable and animatable, when everything in it has a layer in Riptide; otherwise as one picture.
